name: Ceipal Workforce
description_en:
Ceipal Workforce is a workforce-management product for staffing operations, connecting employee records with placements, timesheets, onboarding documents and back-office financial preparation. It is a distinct part of Ceipal’s portfolio alongside its applicant tracking and vendor management systems.

The product is most usefully evaluated around an employed consultant and their assignment: who the client and manager are, which pay and bill rates apply, what documents expire, and whether time and expenses are ready for processing. Recruitment AI and other ATS claims should not automatically be treated as Workforce entitlements.
description_zh:
Ceipal Workforce 是面向人才派遣业务的人员管理产品，把员工档案与派驻安排、工时表、入职文档及后台财务准备相连。它是 Ceipal 产品组合中的独立部分，与招聘跟踪系统和供应商管理系统并列。

评估可围绕一名顾问及其派驻任务展开：客户及经理是谁、适用什么工资与客户计费费率、哪些文档即将到期、工时和费用是否已可处理。招聘 AI 等 ATS 的宣传不能自动视为 Workforce 的购买权益。

core_features.name_zh: 关联派驻任务的员工档案
core_features.explanation_en: Employee dashboards link placement dates, pay and bill information, managers, documents and timesheet status.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工看板关联派驻日期、工资及客户计费信息、经理、文档和工时表状态。

core_features.explanation_en: Teams can modify onboarding documents, set cross-team permissions and track authorization information.
core_features.explanation_zh: 团队可修改入职文档、设置跨团队权限并跟踪工作授权资料。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees submit timesheets, expenses and requests, and access organization documents and payment records.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工提交工时、费用及申请，并访问组织文档和付款记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Workforce describes preparing timesheet, paid-leave and deposit data into reports; this is not proof of an end-to-end payroll tax service.
core_features.explanation_zh: Workforce 说明可把工时、带薪休假及直接存款资料整理为报表，不能据此认定包含完整工资及税务服务。

pricing.summary_en: Workforce pricing requires a sales inquiry; amount, billing basis, implementation and ATS dependencies remain unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: Workforce 需向销售询价；金额、计费依据、实施和 ATS 依赖尚未核实。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Follow the assignment as well as the employee
sections.title_zh: 同时跟踪员工与派驻任务
sections.en: For a staffing firm, a person’s record alone is insufficient: placement dates, client bill rates, pay details and reporting managers determine operational and financial work. Ceipal documents a dashboard that combines these with timesheets, purchase orders and expiration dates. An illustrative evaluation could change a consultant’s assignment end date and check which document reminders, timesheets and invoices require attention. The product pages support the existence of these related records, but do not establish every recalculation or downstream update; demonstrate those explicitly before relying on them.
sections.zh: 人才派遣公司仅有人事档案还不够：派驻日期、客户计费费率、工资信息和汇报经理共同决定运营及财务处理。Ceipal 说明看板把这些内容与工时表、采购订单和到期日结合。评估示例可以修改顾问派驻结束日，再检查哪些文档提醒、工时表和发票需要处理。官方页面支持存在这些关联记录，但未证明所有重新计算和下游更新都会自动完成，依赖之前需逐项演示。

sections.en: Digital onboarding lets teams customize documents, set permissions across teams and track authorization details. Job Termination provides an offboarding workflow with documentation and notifications. Workforce also describes work-authorization and immigration document tracking, including I-9-related material. Those are administrative capabilities, not a determination of immigration eligibility or legal compliance. For onboarding, agree who supplies a document, who reviews it and what happens when it expires. For offboarding, test the last timesheet, retained documents and access changes rather than assuming a termination button completes all obligations.
sections.zh: 数字入职支持自定义文档、设置跨团队权限及跟踪工作授权资料。Job Termination 提供离职文档和通知流程。Workforce 还描述工作授权及移民资料跟踪，包括 I-9 相关材料。这些属于行政管理能力，不能决定移民资格或保证法律合规。入职时需明确谁提供、谁审核文档以及到期后如何处理；离职时需检查最后一期工时、保留文件和权限变更，不能假定点击终止就完成全部义务。

sections.title_en: Keep submissions separate from final processing
sections.title_zh: 区分员工提交与最终处理
sections.en: The self-service portal accepts timesheets, expenses, leads, PTO and asset requests. Employees can access policies, documents and payment records, while managers can send updates and employees can track internal requests. For example, a consultant may submit 40 hours and an expense receipt, but approval, client billing and payroll release remain separate acceptance points to demonstrate. Workforce calls its payroll capability data automation: assembling timesheet, paid-leave and direct-deposit information into a report. Do not infer that this alone calculates and remits every payroll tax. A two-way QuickBooks integration is advertised; mapping, duplicate prevention and error recovery were not executed.
sections.zh: 自助门户接收工时、费用、业务线索、带薪休假和资产申请。员工可访问政策、文档和付款记录，经理可发布通知，员工可跟踪内部请求。例如顾问提交 40 小时和费用凭证后，批准、客户计费和工资发放仍是需要单独演示的验收点。Workforce 将工资能力表述为数据自动化：把工时、带薪休假及直接存款信息整理成报表，不能推断它因此计算并缴纳所有工资税。官方宣传双向 QuickBooks 集成，但未执行字段映射、去重或错误恢复。

sections.title_zh: 单独确认 Workforce 报价范围
sections.en: The reviewed Workforce pages provide demo calls to action, and the official contact page provides sales and support contact routes. No Workforce price, billing unit, minimum commitment or implementation fee was published in these sources. Request a quote stating employee and administrator counts, countries, onboarding, self-service, financial functions and any ATS dependency. Do not import a Ceipal ATS price or security claim into this product record. In particular, a portfolio page’s ATS-specific assurance does not independently verify the audit scope of Workforce. No sustained free plan, open-source license or self-hosted edition was established.
sections.zh: 所读 Workforce 页面引导预约演示，官方联系页提供销售和支持渠道。这些来源未公布 Workforce 的金额、计费单位、最低承诺或实施费。报价应写明员工及管理员人数、国家、入职、自助、财务功能和是否依赖 ATS，不能把 Ceipal ATS 的价格或安全声明直接用于本产品。尤其产品组合中针对 ATS 的保证，不能独立验证 Workforce 的审计范围。本次也未确立长期免费套餐、开源许可或自托管版本。

sections.title_en: Useful when placements drive back-office work
sections.title_zh: 适合由派驻任务驱动后台管理的业务
sections.en: Workforce is a plausible shortlist for staffing operators coordinating consultants, assignments and back-office data. A company wanting only basic internal leave records may find this assignment-oriented scope unnecessary. Before migration, reconcile employee identifiers, clients, placements, rates, document expiry rules and the authoritative accounting system. Include an expired authorization, rejected timesheet and changed bill rate in the demonstration. Actual account permissions, import and export completeness, integration retry behavior, regional payroll coverage and contract terms remain unverified; vendor efficiency and satisfaction claims were not measured.
sections.zh: 对于需要协调顾问、派驻安排和后台数据的人才派遣运营团队，Workforce 值得列入候选。只需基础内部休假记录的公司可能不需要这种以派驻为中心的范围。迁移前应对齐员工编号、客户、派驻任务、费率、文档到期规则和权威会计系统，并在演示中加入授权到期、工时拒批和客户计费费率变更。实际权限、导入导出完整性、集成重试、地区工资覆盖和合同条款均未核实，也未测量供应商所称的效率和满意度改善。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No tenant, financial report, payroll release or QuickBooks integration was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试租户、财务报表、工资发放或 QuickBooks 集成。

research_gaps.en: Workforce-specific security audit scope, retention, hosting, export and regional service terms were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实 Workforce 专属安全审计范围、保留期限、托管、导出及地区服务条款。
